easy.title: Rock Paper Scissors
easy.adminInfo: Players play best two out of three

easy.title: Thumb War
easy.adminInfo: Players thumb wrestle on a table, must keep elbows on the table and hold the thumb for three secods

easy.title: Concentration 64
easy.adminInfo: Players play concentration 64 host calls out the category, first to miss one loses

medium.title: Leg Wrestling
medium.adminInfo: Players leg wrestle for points for the round

medium.title: Paper Airplane
medium.adminInfo: Players have 1 minute make paper airplanes and whoever's toss goes the farthest wins.

medium.title: Pong
medium.adminInfo: One cup per player, first to make it wins. Player who picked challenge goes first

medium.title: Rhyme Challenge
medium.adminInfo: Host calls out a word to rhyme with, whoever can't think of the next rhyme loses.

hard.title: Reverse Charades
hard.adminInfo: Both teams play reverse charades for 1 minute, most points wins.

hard.title: Catch Phrase
hard.adminInfo: Teams play a round of catch phrase, whoever gets the most in one minute wins.
